# A water trough: a wooden box 1.2 x 0.5 x 0.4 m with water inside. Up Z.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.522 0.298 0.188 --no-slot
material new Water --base-color 0.427 0.761 0.792 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name A --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.200 0.200
scale 1.200 0.080 0.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name B --size 1 --location 0.000 0.200 0.200
scale 1.200 0.080 0.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name C --size 1 --location 0.560 0.000 0.200
scale 0.080 0.480 0.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name D --size 1 --location -0.560 0.000 0.200
scale 0.080 0.480 0.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name E --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.300
scale 1.040 0.320 0.040
apply --scale
material assign Water
select all
shade flat
export trough.glb
